Canadian PM Mark Carney hosts president in Calgary, where he grew up alongside large Ukrainian community

The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, made the announcement in Quito, where he met Ecuadorian president Daniel Noboa, one of several rightwing allies of Donald Trump whom Rubio is courting as a security partner during a three-nation tour through Latin America that began on Tuesday.

Andrew Frederick’s body was found in property he was staying at in Grenada in January

Andrew Frederick’s body was found in the property he was staying at in Grenada on 4 January. An autopsy, performed in the same week by a privately hired pathologist, concluded that the 47-year-old’s death was a homicide.

topArticle.description: The LA Rams will face the San Francisco 49ers in the first regular season American football game to be played Down Under.
topArticle.titleJa: アメリカンフットボールがオーストラリアに上陸 - 成功するのか？
topArticle.summary: NFLのLAラムズとサンフランシスコ49ersがオーストラリアで初のレギュラーシーズン戦を行う。果たして成功するのか注目される。

topArticle.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
topArticle.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
topArticle.titleJa: ロシア連邦、一部の平鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
topArticle.summary: ロシア連邦は、ユーラシア経済連合への輸入ポリマー被覆平鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始をWTOに通報した。

topArticle.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice
topArticle.description: On 2 September 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 31 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of hulled rice, semi-whitened or whitened rice, polished or glazed, and broken rice.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の米に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは、精米、半精米、磨き米、砕米の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報した。
